label: SB-19 compression axis: gzip on/off pairs on 64 KiB unary and streaming (contract sections 3.4, 3.5 holdout)
methodology: server cells only: each server peer under test driven by the fixed native open-loop Poisson generator, one discarded warmup probe then 3 measured repeats at the frozen offered rate. Identity (off) cells run; gzip (on) cells are FROZEN definitions that the runner reports unsupported at this base (rpc-bench `load` has no compression flag), never silently skipped or faked. Validation stage: pass means the cell ran, every offered call reconciles, and no repeat is generator-capped (SB-11 client-CPU signal or rejections); no leadership threshold here. Cell order is frozen: peers in file order x cells in file order.
payload_caveat: rpc-bench load payloads are zero bytes, so a future gzip-on cell measures near-maximum compressibility, not typical production entropy. Any gzip claim must name this payload pattern (contract 10.2); zeros are the standard load pattern, not benchmark-specific tuning (contract 10.3).

cells.note: gzip-off half of the pair; identical wire to an SB-11 uncompressed cell, run explicitly to prove the pair structure
FROZEN, unrunnable at this base: needs a load compression flag plus per-peer gzip negotiation; runner reports unsupported
gzip-off streaming half; 8 x 64 KiB msgs (512 KiB/RPC) keeps the pair runnable — the 2000-msg primary count would be 128 MiB/RPC at this payload
FROZEN, unrunnable at this base: same missing load compression flag; runner reports unsupported
